name: kol-emet-server
_comment_qs_pin: CVE-2026-82562 (array-limit bypass) is fixed in qs 6.16.0, but express 4 pins ~6.15.1. Forced rather than moving to express 5, which is a breaking major. Declared twice on purpose: yarn reads `resolutions`, npm reads `overrides`, and each silently ignores the other — so a deploy that switched package manager would quietly drop the pin. Revisit when express 4 widens its range; re-verify query-string parsing if changed.
